_comment: The Oathblade's retail-style talent trees: the one source for its talent rank spells (localTools/oathblade/Spells.ps1),
the server's copy (world SQL) and the client's (FrameXML/TalentTreeData.lua), both written by
localTools/talentTree/buildTalentTree.py. Rows run 0-9 from the top, columns 0-6.
A node is open when it is a root or ANY of its parents is fully ranked. A gate closes every row from `row` down until
`cost` points are spent in the rows above it. A tree's points: one every `levelStep` levels from `firstLevel`.
kind: passive (circle), active (square, teaches an ability), choice (octagon: one of two options, one point).
text: the tooltip, `{0}` replaced by that rank's value. aura: a real aura on the rank spell (type, misc), valued
by `auraValues` or else `values`; without one the rank is a dummy the C++ reads (mod-oathblade).
backgroundArt: the retail talent background the window uses, its greens moved to `hue` (buildTalentTreeArt.py),
or `file`: a painting of our own (PNG, about 2:1, figure in the right third) that replaces it, darkened by
`shade` { left, right, vignette } when it is too bright for the trees.
